scope: Root-labelled unary rho augmentation; ordinary agreement forests with no acyclicity requirement.
mutation_rejections: change opposite-ancestry expected krho from 3 to 2
disable vertex-disjointness and accept crossing witness
candidate_theorems: deleting rho maps every augmented forest to an ordinary forest without increasing component count
failure: Any exact control mismatch or missed corruption stops scans; preserve failure before repair.
hand_reasoning: Singleton and equal trees have one component. Unequal rooted triples need one split. Opposite ancestry has disjoint AB/CD with inverted ancestor order, while every 3-label restriction differs and every other 2+2 split overlaps; rho cannot join AB or CD without crossing the other block, so Krho=3. Crossing cherries have no common 3-label restriction and every 2+2 candidate has overlapping spans in one input.
